BiblicalUsage: The word names a veil or covering, and Isaiah uses it for the covering cast over all people and spread over all nations. God promises to destroy that covering on His mountain.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the veil Isaiah names is the blindness and sorrow that hangs over every nation, and God Himself will lift it.
